verdict.rationale: Fern is a documentation platform that generates API reference docs from OpenAPI, so an embedded try-it playground is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an interactive playground, an API explorer, or the ability to send live requests from the reference pages. Generating API reference pages (fern-docs-22, fern-docs-9) is an adjacent feature, not the playground capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, readers can try real API calls from an interactive playground embedded in the reference docs
